svg.title: A parent graph and its transformation
svg.desc: The parent f(x) = x^2 in green with vertex (0, 0), and g(x) = 2f(x - 3) - 1 = 2(x - 3)^2 - 1 in blue with vertex (3, -1): shifted 3 right, stretched vertically by a factor of 2, then shifted 1 down. The point (1, 1) on f moves to (4, 1) on g.
